name: browser-readable-text-session
description: Browser extension packages readable page text as a URL-backed text item for app continuation.

args.title: Inspecting Process Instead of Anecdotes
args.text: Anecdotes are easy to collect and hard to inspect. A useful review follows the process, the paper trail, and the points where evidence can be checked.

assertions: Readable page capture becomes a normal URL-backed text item.
Browser text capture can continue in the app without browser media capabilities.
